changeSet.author: pos

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_type_fields f JOIN business_types bt ON bt.id = f.business_type_id WHERE bt.code = 'PHARMACY' AND f.field_key = 'expiry_date'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO business_type_fields (business_type_id, field_key, label, field_type, required, sort_order) SELECT bt.id, v.field_key, v.label, v.field_type, v.required, v.sort_order FROM business_types bt CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('expiry_date', 'Срок годности', 'DATE', FALSE, 10), ('batch', 'Серия', 'TEXT', FALSE, 20), ('shelf_life_days', 'Срок хранения (дней)', 'NUMBER', FALSE, 30), ('units_in_pack', 'Ед. в упаковке', 'NUMBER', FALSE, 40), ('arrival_date', 'Дата прихода', 'DATE', FALSE, 60) ) AS v(field_key, label, field_type, required, sort_order) WHERE bt.code = 'PHARMACY' ON CONFLICT (business_type_id, field_key) DO NOTHING;
